return {
	[8000185] = { cd = "30s", desc = "Stealths both mount and rider for 30s.\nStealth ends if you move, attack, or are attacked.", icon = "icon_skill_tare01.png", mana = 10, name = "Nui's Veil" },
	[8000187] = { cd = "1m", desc = "Dashes into the otherworld for 5s, then reappears. Slightly increases Move Speed.\nCan't be used while carrying a trade pack.", icon = "icon_skill_horseback03.png", mana = 10, name = "Hereafter Dash" },
	[8000189] = { cd = "30s", desc = "Increases Move Speed |cFFFF9C27+80%|r, then gradually decreases it over 10s.\nCan't be used while carrying a trade pack.", icon = "icon_skill_snowlion05.png", mana = 0, name = "Ghostly Steps" },
	[8000577] = { cd = "10s", desc = "Use a |nc;Flaming Pinion|r to increase glide speed |nc;+30|r% for 30s.", icon = "icon_skill_glider12.png", mana = 0, name = "Flaming Pinion" },
	[8000787] = { cd = "1m", desc = "Aquestria creates sound waves to detect all ships and drydocks within 200m for 10 seconds.", icon = "icon_skill_submarine01.png", mana = 0, name = "Scan Ships" },
	[8000790] = { cd = "25s", desc = "Increases Move Speed |nc;+50|r% for |nc;10|r seconds.\nCan't be used while performing Sharp Dive or Acrobatics.", icon = "icon_skill_seahorse01.png", mana = 0, name = "Aquestria Dash" },
	[8000798] = { cd = "30s", desc = "A quick dive down into the depths.\nCan't be used while Dashing, carrying a trade pack, or performing Acrobatics.", icon = "icon_skill_seahorse02.png", mana = 0, name = "Sharp Dive" },
	[8000800] = { cd = "10s", desc = "Allows Aquestria free rein to frolic as she wishes.\nMay trigger different tricks depending on the creature's mood.\nCan't be used while carrying a trade pack or performing Aquestria Dash or Dive.", icon = "icon_skill_seahorse03.png", mana = 180, name = "Acrobatics" },
	[8000802] = { cd = "40s", desc = "Traps an enemy inside a bubble for 4s and slowly lifts it into the air. Bubble duration reduced -50% in PvP.\nEnemies in bubbles can't attack, but will be freed upon taking damage.\nCan't be used while performing Sharp Dive or Acrobatics.", icon = "icon_skill_seahorse04.png", mana = 0, name = "Bubble Trap" },
}
